Name: Man's voice
Dialog: Last night's meteor may not have been as innocent as we thought...

Name: Man
Dialog: ...look what happened to Dr. Zachary!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (High-fives Ferb) Cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now what? (Walks into the living room) Alright, what are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Watching the Invasion of the Human Overlords marathon. They're playing all five movies tonight!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that all? Pfft. Well enjoy your lame, colorless marathon. I'm heading back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, who's that?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's Dr. Abernathy. He's a scientist!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's kind of hunky for a 50s guy.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Don't worry. I'll you keep safe.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Thanks, doctor, but please call me Amanda.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Alright... Amanda.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sold! (Quickly sits on the couch) Get me up to speed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The aliens are replacing the heads of all the humans with their own shape-shifting, multi-eyed heads, which can then assume the form of the host human.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get out, and then...?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Once they replace more than 51% of all the humans, they can assume control the earth for their own nefarious purposes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Shut up! And...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way! Is there no way to stop them?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If only you can catch them if they're in their human state. That's when they're at their weakest.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then how you can tell if they're aliens?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's three kinds of ways to spot an alien. First, they have strange vocal patterns. They don't get human linguistics.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Pass me that frie-bop, please.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: You mean this hammer?

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Oh, yes, hammer. Frie-bop is what we call it in Ohio... where I'm from.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What else?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're anatomically disproportionate.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Now I need the sprigle-kronk.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: The what?

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Never mind. I'll get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But the clear sign is that they can safely remove any human head, and replace it with their own multi-eyed, shape shifting head.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah. I guess that will give it away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pointing to the TV) Like this.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: Doctor? What's wrong. Are you alright?

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Yes, Amanda. I'm fine. We're all fine, and soon you will be too!

Name: Amanda
Dialog: NOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!

Name: Alien
Dialog: Sorry, Amanda, but we've waited long enough.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: NOOOO!!! (her head is in a jar) This can't be! What's happening?

Name: The real Dr. Abernathy
Dialog: I tried to warn you.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: Doctor, your head is attached! You're human again!

Name: Dr. Abernathy
Dialog: Yes, and once Dr. Zachary returns from heading into those dark, ominous woods alone, with his not fully charged flashlight, you will be too... Amanda.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: But it was all right here! Oh, why did I think anyone would believe me? I was a fool! (sobs) A fool...!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, you guys. That was awesome. Guys? Uh, guys? Wow, it's tomorrow already. I gotta find those guys and tell them how it ended. ... Guys, guys, guys, ugh--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Mom. Have you seen the boys?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, I think they're upstairs. Can you do me a favor and take the laundry up? I'm late for an appointment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks, hon. I'll be back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Holding up a t-shirt) Oh, how cute. Ferb's torso is so tiny. (Upstairs; at Ferb) Oh, there you are. You know, that movie was so...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (shouting indistinctly over computer)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oops, sorry. I'll just put these in your room.<

Name: Ferb's cousin
Dialog: (Scottish accent) Oh, I wish you were there, Ferb.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: So do I. Tell Uncle Angus and Aunt Mora thanks for the candy.

Name: Ferb's cousin
Dialog: Too right. Scotland out. Peace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Phineas. Oh, my gosh, you missed it. By the end everyone got their heads back and everything went back to normal. Well, sort of. The entire laboratory disappeared. But I loved it. I can't look at anything the same way ever again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool, glad you liked it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I-- I almost forgot the coolest part. (In the backyard) Hey, guys. Guys. You're never gonna believe this. At the end, they-- (ominous theme playing) (gasps) Ferb? (sees what looks like Ferb removing his head, she screams and runs to the panic room) Oh, my gosh. Ferb's an alien. Whoa, whoa, whoa. Hang on a second. I'm sure there's a perfectly good reason Ferb can remove his head. I mean, it's not like he had any of the other telltale signs, is it? Oh, no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Strange vocal patterns...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Holding up a t-shirt) Oh, how cute. Ferb's torso is so tiny.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anatomically disproportionate... (gasps) THEY GOT TO FERRRRRB!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Phineas! I-- I know you're gonna think I've completely lost it, but I'm pretty sure that Ferb is an alien. I've got to find his head and re-attach it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My brother's an alien? How cool is that? But I think you may be letting your imagination get the best of you, sis.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, a non-believer, huh? Well, you know what? I'm gonna get proof. You'll see. Ferb's an alien!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about the distraction, Agent P. The ladies are helping to, uh, (reading from a card) "net-roy-er the lair."

Name: Carl
Dialog: Tré biens, Monsieur Monogram. Trés bien.

Name: Maids
Dialog: Bonjour, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Bonjour, Madame.

Name: Maids
Dialog: (giggles)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So we're having a bit of a cleanup here, which coincidentally is what Doofenshmirtz seem to be having as well. He's put some old "-inators" up for sale on an evil auction site. If one of those devices were to fall into the wrong hands, it could be catast—Could—Could you please wait for me to finish, Mimi?

Name: Fifi
Dialog: Non "Mimi." Fifi.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oui, Fifi. (at himself) Oh, now I've lost my train of thought. (at Perry) Anyway, get out to Doof's place and put a stop to it. (at Carl) How much is this costing us, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Une petite fortune.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: "Petite." That means small, right? Well done, Carl.

Name: Maids
Dialog: (giggling)

Name: (Song
Dialog: "You're Not Ferb)"

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (opens the door) Oh, hello. You must be here about the ad, right? Well, come on in. It's right over here. (closes the door; dramatic music) Behold the Wrapped-Up-in-a-Nice-Little-Bow-Inator. (Perry, disguised as an evil scientist, blinks) I bet you're wondering what it does, huh? Well, let's say your nemesis is arriving sooner than expected and- And your place is a complete mess. (camera pans to a messy "bedroom") Tidying up is a snap (snaps fingers) with the press of this large, red button. (pushes aforesaid button) See? Wrapped up in a nice little bow. (close up of a box tied up with a red ribbon) You can also use it to hang your clothes on. (hangs one of his lab coats on the Inator) Just like a treadmill. (camera quickly pans to a treadmill with clothes hanging on it) So although my ad said firm, I am flexible, so make me an offer. (Perry blinks twice; Doofenshmirtz rubs a hand behind his head) Wow, you're a good negotiator. Okay, half price. (camera pans to a baseball bat and a container of baseballs) And I'll throw in my Druselstein minor-league baseball collection.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? (grabs the baseball bat) Well, it's a good thing I still have my Druselstein minor-league bat. (Perry goes into a defensive position) Have at you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggling) Well, Phineas, what do you think? Wait. Before you say anything, look at these photos. I stalked "Ferb" all day. (shows Phineas some photos) See? Proof positive. Ferb...is an ALIEN.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, well—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, no, just wait till you see. Here, here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here, here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here and here. And listen to this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine. Here, here, wait, what about this hideous ball of goo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Listen, Candace, as cool as it would be for Ferb to be an alien, that's sadly not the case. Here, follow me and I'll show you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, show me what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, old pal, our dear sister here thinks you may be a sinister extraterrestrial visitor.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I saw Ferb's head ripped off by a hideous alien monster.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you must mean this reverse power coupling unit we're repairing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Reverse power coupling unit?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. That's all it was. Ferb's no more alien than you or me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—But what about all this evidence I've been collecting?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, even though Ferb's not an alien, we are fixing a spacecraft for a friend of Meap's.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just finished and we're about to launch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb, you're not an alien!...uh, you're about to launch? You guys are so busted, I'm getting Mom!

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: (poking an uncooked chicken) Go. Go. You're free, little skin bird.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (quietly) Mom?

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: Oh! Candace, you scared the bejabbers out of me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, I've got something to show you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the backyard)Seriously, Mom, I've waited for this moment a long time. (to Phineas and Ferb) All right, you two, let's get this show on the road!

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: Yes.

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: You two have done a great job repairing my ship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So busted! Ha -- (stops dancing) Huh? Your ship?

Name: Meap's friend
Dialog: (speaks in alien dialect)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, Garbog. I hope you finished your study on the habits of the human female parental unit.

Name: Garbog
Dialog: (speaks in alien dialect)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I -- I -- (sobbing)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (When Doofenshmirtz grows too much, he pushes his inator away. Perry then jumps onto it and escapes.)Curse you, Perry the Plat- (he groans, then spits out a chair) Why did I ever order such a large bedroom set?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Wow, you know, it's quite a bit roomier in here than you'd think.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mother? Is that you? I mean, really you?

Name: The real Linda
Dialog: Candace, I don't have time right now. I have frozens.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep. That's you. (pushes her) Come on, Mom, quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice design on that rocket gantry, by the way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And it folds up for easy storage. Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Please, please, please, please be there...!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) And I'm seeing...the backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: NOOOOOO!!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sobs) But it was all right here! Oh, why did I think anyone would believe me? I was a fool! (sobs again) A fool...!
